posts.title: AI Lacks Nuance
posts.description: AI slop is becoming much more common. Long blocks of text that ramble on repeating the same simple thought are commonplace. Many people are learning to overcome the lack of conciseness with AI simply by asking it to use fewer words, remove filler or get to the point. posts.title: Better vs Different
posts.description: Is this better, or is it just different? This is a question I keep coming back to. One example of this is the light switch. In the 80s, people tried to invent a better light switch. The Clapper fascinated me as a kid. This was a lamp that was activated by clapping to turn it on or off.
